text: Starr Insurance Companies is a privately held international insurance group whose ultimate parent is Starr International Company, Inc. (SICO), tracing back to Cornelius Vander Starr, with no state ownership.

source.name: Legal Clarity Starr Insurance parent company page
source.quote: The ultimate parent of the insurance operations is Starr International Company, Inc. (commonly called SICO), a private holding company now domiciled in Switzerland
